spec.hypothesis: FewRel RE task replicates confusability effect: high-BCS batches have lower accuracy than low-BCS batches, across count levels
spec.design: exp1: count curve (7 levels: 1,4,8,16,32,64,80), 5 random batches per level. exp2: BCS-controlled (25 random + extreme batches per count). Two-stage (preprocess CPU + extract GPU subprocess). MiniLM embeddings for BCS.
